Definition: {Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire}
BiblicalUsage: Babel or Babylon = "confusion (by mixing)"; 1) Babel or Babylon, the ancient site and/or capital of Babylonia (modern Hillah) situated on the Euphrates
